query: SELECT agent.id, CASE WHEN player_character.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'player' WHEN npc_agent.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'npc' WHEN world_gm.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'world_gm' WHEN world_role_agent.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN world_role_agent.role ELSE 'unknown' END AS "role!: String", COALESCE(pc.name, npc.name) AS character_name, NULL AS "location_name?: String" FROM agent LEFT JOIN player_character ON player_character.agent_id = agent.id LEFT JOIN character AS pc ON pc.id = player_character.character_id LEFT JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.agent_id = agent.id LEFT JOIN character AS npc ON npc.id = npc_agent.character_id LEFT JOIN world_gm ON world_gm.agent_id = agent.id LEFT JOIN world_role_agent ON world_role_agent.agent_id = agent.id WHERE agent.world_id = ? ORDER BY agent.id
